name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
instructions: Set the seat so the pads sit just above your elbows and your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Sit tall against the back pad, take the handles and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Drive the pads out and up with the sides of your shoulders until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Pause at the top, then lower under control without letting the stack touch down between reps.
